title: Pirate
description: Pirate speech is a nautical, swashbuckling register marked by 'arr', 'matey', 'ye', 'aye', 'me hearties', and salty sea slang. It is contrasted with the same content delivered in plain modern English. Contrast: plain modern English phrasing.
